result.rationale: Both records concern the same unprocessed red meat contrast and bladder cancer incidence estimate. The abstract supports validation's population description and smoking-adjustment statement, although adjustment does not establish participants' smoking stratum. It does not explicitly establish that participants were free of bladder cancer at baseline, so the JBI q6 change from Unclear to Yes and resulting score difference cannot be resolved. Full text is needed to verify baseline disease exclusions; human review should clarify smoking_status field semantics. Neither record can be recommended intact on abstract evidence alone.
result.evidence_quote: adjusted for smoking status and duration and other potential confounders
